answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with proof-of-burn admission: to mint an identity, an agent must irreversibly destroy tokens at a provably-unspendable address, capital gone for good, not a refundable bond. Spinning up 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 separate burns, so the marginal delta on each extra identity is pure deadweight loss. Like a spent comet the stake never returns, and the on-chain burn receipt is a public beacon peers verify before trusting the agent.
